name: Wine Ticket
summary: In Stormwind, Renato Gallina hands out Wine Tickets to bring customers to his family's shop. Present one to Suzetta Gallina for a complimentary bottle of Pinot Noir.

sections.title: Promoting the Family Vintage
sections.body: Renato Gallina promotes the Gallina Winery with printed tickets near Stormwind's Trade District. The winery is a boutique vintage shop along the nearby canals. Each ticket promises a complimentary sample of Pinot Noir, drawing curious passersby and newly arrived adventurers toward the family business in hopes they become loyal customers.

faq.q: What do I do with the Wine Ticket?
aliases: where do i bring wine ticket
faq.answer: Take the Wine Ticket to Suzetta Gallina at the Gallina Winery along the canals in Stormwind's Trade District. She will redeem it for a complimentary bottle of Pinot Noir.
Renato Gallina hands out the tickets near the Trade District, drawing prospective customers to his family's wine shop.

faq.q: What kind of wine does the ticket reward?
faq.answer: The ticket can be redeemed for a bottle of Pinot Noir, one of the finest wines the Gallina family sells in the kingdom.

angles.text: A bottle of Pinot Noir from this ticket pairs well with hearty meats and cheeses gathered throughout the Eastern Kingdoms.
